title: Aged Inventory Surcharge Terms (FBN)
content:
On each monthly assessment of Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) inventory the units of a SKU are aged first-in-first-out from their receipt dates, and every unit aged 181 days or more is billed the surcharge of its age band per cubic foot; in the 366-plus band the greater of the per-cubic-foot amount and the per-unit minimum times units is billed. Units on a removal order created on or before the assessment date are excluded. An enrollment within its aged surcharge exemption days after activation pays no surcharge.

## Ageing first in first out

The oldest units of a SKU are taken to leave first. The units still on hand on the assessment date are therefore the most recently received ones, and each is aged from the receipt date of the receipt it came from.

Illustration (hypothetical): 100 units received on day 0 and 100 units received on day 200; 120 units shipped since. On day 400 the 80 units on hand are the remainder of the day-200 receipt, aged 200 days, which falls in the band of 181 to 270 days.

## The charge per band

| Band on the assessment date | Charge for the SKU's units in the band |
|---|---|
| under 181 days | none |
| 181 to 270 days | band rate per cubic foot times the cubic feet of those units, rounded to the cent |
| 271 to 365 days | band rate per cubic foot times the cubic feet of those units, rounded to the cent |
| 366 days or more | the greater of: the band rate per cubic foot times the cubic feet, rounded to the cent; and the per-unit minimum times the units, rounded to the cent |

Example for the oldest band (hypothetical rates): 40 units occupying 2 cubic feet, at 6.00 USD per cubic foot and 0.15 USD per unit, give 12.00 USD and 6.00 USD; 12.00 USD is billed. The same 40 units occupying 0.5 cubic feet give 3.00 USD against 6.00 USD; 6.00 USD is billed.

## Units and enrollments left out

- Units on a removal order created on or before the assessment date are not assessed; a removal order created after the assessment date does not exclude them.
- An enrollment still within the aged surcharge exemption days of its program, counted from its activation, pays no surcharge on that assessment.
